originalLicenseNote: Engine source under MIT; embeds the network renegade-net-36.bin from the engine's own repository, trained on its self-play games.
blurb: Renegade 1.3.0 is the June 2026 release of Krisztián Peőcz's MIT-licensed C++ UCI chess engine, developed since 2022 and trained purely on its own self-play games. It pairs magic bitboards, singular, double, triple and low-depth singular extensions, late-move, history, futility and SEE pruning, and pawn, non-pawn and follow-up correction histories with an embedded horizontally mirrored perspective NNUE of 14 king input buckets, a 1600x2 hidden layer and 8 material output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper (Threads fixed to 1); the net runs on the engine's portable path, vectorized by clang to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native Haswell build's; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Pregenerated magic numbers with attack tables built at startup.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening and aspiration windows at higher depths.

features.label: Mate Distance Pruning
features.implementation: Alpha and beta bounded by the mate distance from the root.

features.label: Reverse Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Whole-node pruning when the corrected static eval clears beta by a depth margin.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Depth- and eval-scaled null-move reduction in the whole-node pruning stage.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: One ply less on cut nodes from depth 6 where the hash table holds no move.

features.label: Late-Move & History Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, history, futility and SEE pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double and triple extensions with multi-cut and negative extensions, plus low-depth singular extensions.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Logarithmic reductions in 1/256-ply units, adjusted by history and node type.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Captures with SEE and futility pruning in leaf nodes.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Threat-aware quiet and capture histories and continuation history, with pawn, non-pawn and follow-up correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Clustered hash table with generations, bounds, static evals and TT-PV flags.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded integer perspective net: 768 inputs in 14 mirrored king buckets, 1600x2 hidden with SCReLU, 8 material output buckets.
